resolved_findings.initial_gap: New seal froze current implementation but did not require original production/old-runner/support bytes to match the old seal before source access.
resolved_findings.resolution: Every current and historical old-seal src/cami Python source, original runner and original support require original sealed hashes. Union of inventories also rejects additions/deletions. Denial fixtures reject changed repository/runner/support hashes and a missing historical source without tracked edits.

pre_access_boundary.global_inputs: Existing sealed-input gate verifies complete fixed cohort, exact AI/private/public review binding, provenance assumptions, source hashes, four variants, exact commit IDs and denominators. Extension requires unchanged old paths/hashes, original parent/root/claim inputs, old prefix, old completed artifact identity/inventory and original implementation identity.
pre_access_boundary.global_topology: All groups complete metadata-only gate before either read_snapshot or reference_claim. Pinned boundary/HEAD, boundary first-parent path, exact next twelve successors, full ordered parent lists, first-parent==previous, step order/uniqueness/merge flags and global/group strata are checked.
pre_access_boundary.source_scope: Execution loops read only original parent and twelve explicitly authorized child snapshots per group. Side parents are recorded metadata, never requested as trees/sources. Authored source-reader denial wrappers enforce this, including octopus merges.
pre_access_boundary.old_contract: Original production chain and original runner remain byte-identical and still reject a merge before their source reads. New mode has separate protocol/helper/driver and never monkeypatches the original chain.

execution_semantics.before_current: Each transition compares current full merged snapshot only against immediately preceding first-parent snapshot/index; loop asserts previous revision and advances both after each step.
execution_semantics.state_selection: Reinitializes all four variants at original parent using actual production validation, then runs genuine production selection/validation/advance on each variant own states. File variant uses current-index unresolved/limitation fields as original production driver. No imported old policy state.
execution_semantics.reference_separation: Child reference decisions are computed only after all variant policy transitions. Prior completed results are consulted only for later overlap verification, never to choose policy selections or states.
execution_semantics.merge_behavior: Authored checks cover merged signature change, merge tree identical to first parent but different from side parent, deletion/ambiguity/parse uncertainty/recovery and multi-parent ordering.

semantic_overlap.inventory: Exactly 448 old claim-child-variant observations and 24 parent records must match.
semantic_overlap.compared: Entire old parent and observation records, including eligibility/exclusions, AI bindings, claim/predicate/provenance fields, selection reasons, previous/current states, last-check history, validation and full-production input hashes/verdicts/reasons, and reference identities/source hashes/facts/evidence.
semantic_overlap.ignored_only: Validation CPU/duration fields, explicit reference input-case/packet/case paths, and newly added trajectory annotations absent from the old schema.
semantic_overlap.failure: Mismatch produces detailed old/new semantic hashes and differences, then fails preserved run; never silently reseals.

reporting.partitions: New+old is a coverage partition; merge+nonmerge is a topology partition of the same rows. These are overlapping descriptions, not additive independent samples.
reporting.limits: Same claims/modules/history, development selection and prior exposure remain dependent and outcome-informed. Merge strata are descriptive, not causal. Reference uncertainty/available_unknown and parent exclusions remain distinct from false availability. Empty new stratum in the previously twelve-step group remains explicit.
